Name: Sir Robert's Flower Shop Plants
Author: sirrobertsmom
Description:
[size=4][u][color=#efefef][b]Description[/b][/color][/u][/size]
[color=#efefef][size=4]This mod uses flowers and plants "recycled and cleaned up" from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43970]Sir Robert's Tabletop Plants[/url]. Basically, I want to use everything that I've created to decorate the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36501]H&W Buildable Flower Shop[/url], but I realized the colors from my earlier mods didn't quite fit with the aesthetic of my current pixel sprites...[/size][/color]

[color=#efefef][size=4]So I made some changes to the original artwork from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43970]Sir Robert's Tabletop Plants[/url], added my favorite houseplants from the Stardew Valley furniture catalog, which I tastelfully recolored; and before I knew it, I had a brand new mod to share with you.[/size][/color]

[color=#efefef][size=4]There are 17 flowers and houseplants, which can be found in the Decor Section of the furniture catalog or Happy Home Designer. Each image has a variety of colors and pots to choose from via Alternative Textures. Please note: Image #1 has two slighty different shades of green leaves--they aren't accidental duplicates. I just couldn't decide which shade of green that I liked best! Image #7 has options available with or without berries.[/size][/color]

[color=#efefef][size=4]Feel free to mix & match with my other mods or pair them with houseplants from another mod author! I want you to have as many flowers & houseplants as possible to decorate your home in Stardew Valley or fill a flower shop with greenery. Happy decorating![/size][/color]

[size=4][u][color=#efefef][b]Installation instructions[/b][/color][/u][/size]
[color=#efefef][size=4]Install the latest version of SMAPI. Download this mod and unzip it directly into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size][/color]

[size=4][u][color=#efefef][b]Main features[/b][/color][/u][/size]
[color=#efefef][size=4]Images #1 through #17 can be placed on end tables.[/size][/color]

[color=#efefef][size=4]Image #18 has been moved up a few pixels and can be placed on kitchen countertops. They will fit perfectly on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34287]PC's Shabby Chic Kitchen[/url] by Platinum Cats and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20541]Lovely Kitchen Islands and Extras (AT)[/url] by lululovely.[/size][/color]

[size=4][u][color=#efefef][b]Requirements[/b][/color][/u][/size]
[color=#efefef][size=4]Requires the Content Patcher and Alternative Textures. I also recommend using Happy Home Designer. I also recommend using Precise Furniture for any large potted plant that you place on the floor--you can move them around pixel-by-pixel and it will make decorating so much easier.[/size][/color]

[size=4][u][color=#efefef][b]Shout outs[/b][/color][/u][/size]
[color=#efefef][size=4]The end tables in the pictures are from mods made by Platinum Cats, lululovely and Hime Tarts & Wildflour. I also used end tables from the Stardew Valley furniture catalog. The last picture is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36501]H&W Buildable Flower Shop[/url]; and the flowers & plants on the walls of the flower shop are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16717]H&W Greenhouse Furniture[/url].[/size][/color]
